relevance_note: This is a pooled literature review ("We reviewed the HA20 cases in previous literature") of 89 previously published HA20 patients; the patient-level data are only in a supplementary table ("(Table S1)") that is not part of this text, so no individual person can be extracted.
method_note: Read the full Markdown by hand; no script transcribed any table. Tables 1-3 give only group-level percentages (OTU+ZnF, OTU, ZnF groups); patient-level data (Table S1, Table S2, Figure S1) are supplementary and absent from the text. Variants are named only at group level (p.Leu227^*, p.Phe224Serfs^*4, p.Gln370Argfs^*16, deletion of exons 2-3 of TNFAIP3 cited to case report (13)) and are not attributed to any labelled person, so the individuals, variants, phenotypic_features and phenotype_checklist tables are left empty. prior_report_citation records the reference numbers the text gives for its source cases ((5, 8, 10–12) and (13)); the full per-patient source list is in Table S1, which is unavailable. Internal inconsistencies noted: (1) the abstract gives the OTU+ZnF onset as 'median:6, IQR:1-10' while the Results text and Table 1 give '6 (1.165-7)'; (2) '89 patients from 39 families' versus group family counts of 23 + 3 + 3 = 29 families; (3) the ZnF group is said to contain 13 distinct variants (11 frameshift, 1 nonsense, 1 missense) yet only 3 families; (4) treatment response rates are attributed to 'Table S2' in the text but appear in Table 3.
